beats.narration_text: Liam, in for Bear — the last part of the Musinique mark. The living set: the mark summoned inside the Claude composer, a stroke pulse on a heartbeat rhythm, a four-percent breathing scale, and three exits back to back. Every logo needs a way out.

Your turn. Paste this: give my logo an idle state — a slow four percent breathe and a stroke pulse — plus one exit, and argue for which exit my brand should actually use. Idle states are the most underrated logo motion there is.
Musinique, in motion. Part five. That's all twenty moves. Liam, in for Bear.
